description: Pakistan Synthetics Limited was incorporated on 18 November 1984 and converted into a public limited company on 30 December 1987; its shares are listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. The company's principal activity is the manufacture and sale of plastic and crown caps and polyester staple fibre, and it markets PET resin, PET preforms and closure caps for packaging customers. It runs factory operations at Port Qasim in Karachi and in the Hub industrial trading estate in Balochistan.
